title: Tom's Pocket Money
text:
Tom gets pocket money from his parents every Friday. He gets ten pounds each week. He saves some of the money in a box. He spends the rest on sweets and comics.

Last month, Tom wanted a new football. It was very expensive, so he saved his money for three weeks. Now he has the ball, and he plays with his friends in the park every Saturday.

questions.text: How often does Tom get his pocket money?
What did Tom want to buy last month?
Why did Tom save his money for three weeks?
options: He wanted to buy something expensive
He wanted to give money to his friends
His parents stopped giving him money

questions.text: What can we say about Tom from the first paragraph?
options: He spends all his money at once
He is careful with his money

paragraph_translations: Tom dostaje kieszonkowe od rodziców każdy piątek. Co tydzień dostaje dziesięć funtów. Część pieniędzy odkłada w pudełku. Resztę wydaje na słodycze i komiksy.
W zeszłym miesiącu Tom chciał nową piłkę nożną. Była bardzo droga, więc przez trzy tygodnie oszczędzał pieniądze. Teraz ma piłkę i co sobotę gra w parku z kolegami.
